tokens.name: chassis
tokens.usage: App ground and diagram canvas.

tokens.usage: Code wells: listing, decompile, hex, diff, log tail, inputs.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px separators and diagram card strokes. Decorative; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-node
tokens.usage: Stroke of companion-diagram contract boxes and step cards.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, buttons, checkboxes; 3.2:1 or better on chassis, pane, raised and well. On selection it is 2.37:1, so inside selected rows control borders use ink-muted (3.78:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on chassis, pane, raised, well and selection. Safe on: chassis 12.8:1, pane 11.3:1, raised 9.8:1, well 13.4:1, selection 7.2:1.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Titles, the selected label, state words on selection, text on every family header fill. Safe on every ground: 9.0:1 on selection, 12.3:1 or more on the other surfaces, 8.0:1 or more on family and fault fills.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on chassis, pane, raised and well (6.7, 6.0, 5.2 and 7.1:1). On selection it is 3.78:1: text is promoted to ink there, and it serves as the non-text boundary that replaces line-control inside selected rows.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls only; carries no information (4.1:1 on chassis, 2.3:1 on selection).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one chrome accent: focus ring, active tab rule, links, hovered splitter. Never a status. Safe on every ground: 5.0:1 on selection, 6.8:1 or more elsewhere.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px outline at offset 0 on bordered controls; 3px inset (focus-inset-w) on rows, cells, tabs, in-row inputs and links in clipped wells. 3:1 or better on every surface, 5.0:1 on selection.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary selected row, token, line or tab.

tokens.name: address
tokens.usage: Addresses, RVAs, offsets and byte counts in mono. Safe on every ground: 6.4:1 on selection, 8.7:1 or more elsewhere.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim under the palette and confirm dialogs.

tokens.name: gate
tokens.usage: Gate diamonds, 'Gate:' labels, concurrency brackets.

tokens.name: lock
tokens.usage: Ownership locks: serialized, one owner.

tokens.name: status-claim
tokens.usage: Claim-status lines: DESIGN ONLY, NOT RUN, FUTURE / NOT RUN.

tokens.name: fact-passed
tokens.usage: Glyph of a fact that passed with a receipt. Never a fill, banner or celebration. 5.7:1 on selection, 7.8:1 or more elsewhere.

tokens.name: fact-failed
tokens.usage: Glyph of a failed fact; faults, conflicts, contested, containment. 6.1:1 or more on chassis, pane, raised and well; 4.46:1 on selection, where glyphs use fact-failed-on-selection.

tokens.name: fact-failed-on-selection
tokens.usage: Failed glyph on the selection fill only (5.23:1). Never a word and never a second failed hue.

tokens.name: fact-stale
tokens.usage: Glyph of stale facts, partial state, waiting at a gate, approval-required. 5.9:1 on selection, 8.0:1 or more elsewhere.

tokens.name: fact-unknown
tokens.usage: Glyph of unknown, unsupported and not_run facts (always dashed). 4.9:1 on selection, 6.6:1 or more elsewhere.
